name: LubeLogger
short_description: Self-hosted vehicle maintenance and fuel log tracker.
description: LubeLogger is a self-hosted vehicle service record and fuel mileage tracker. Log oil changes, tire rotations, repairs, and fuel fill-ups to track costs and maintenance schedules for all your vehicles.
usecases: Log and track vehicle maintenance history and costs.
Monitor fuel efficiency and mileage over time.
Receive reminders for upcoming scheduled maintenance.
